arguments.sql:
SELECT ml.state AS state, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM transactions t
JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id
WHERE length(ml.state) = 2 AND ml.state <> '' AND ml.state = UPPER(ml.state)
GROUP BY ml.state
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, ml.state ASC
LIMIT 5
arguments.explanation: Counts all transactions by US state of the merchant location and returns the five states with the most, highest first.
assumptions: US states are the two-letter state codes in merchant_locations.state; country names and online locations (empty state) are excluded.
Counts include all transactions, labelled or not, and include transactions with negative amounts.
Ties are ordered by state code alphabetically.
